title: Add GimpToPolli to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [GimpToPolli](https://github.com/GermanIllan/pollinationsai) to image
- ### 🌸 App Submission: GimpToPolli - **App Name:** GimpToPolli - **Author / Developer:** [@GermanIllan](https://github.com/GermanIllan) - **Repository URL:** https://github.com/GermanIllan/pollination

Fixes #13209

gist.headline: GIMP found the garden
gist.blurb: GimpToPolli has joined the app greenhouse. GIMP artists can now bring pollinations.ai image generation into the same workspace as their pixels, layers, and extremely specific selections.
gist.summary: Added GimpToPolli by @GermanIllan to the app catalog, highlighting a community-built bridge between GIMP and pollinations.ai image generation.
gist.impact: Artists browsing the pollinations.ai app catalog can now discover GimpToPolli as a way to pair GIMP workflows with image generation.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy pixel-art artist workstation where Polli helps a friendly GIMP-style desktop editor create a blooming image from a canvas. The key symbols are a retro monitor showing a simple layered pixel landscape, a painter's palette and brush, and code-flowers growing from the desk to represent the app catalog connection; Polli wears a tiny painter's beret and warmly guides the creative process.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown stripes, black antennae and oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a happy smile, and small rounded translucent light-blue wings, wearing a tiny painter's beret while hovering beside a retro art workstation; a friendly chunky desktop image editor on a CRT monitor displays a layered pixel garden canvas as flowers and code-plants sprout around it. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, dark purple (#110518) outlines, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with small pixel-font text: "GIMP TO POLLI".
